name: wdk-wallet-extension
description: WDK Wallet Extension — a production-grade, self-custodial Chrome/Brave browser extension wallet built on Tether's Wallet Development Kit (WDK). Reference implementation for the Tether WDK 'Browser Extension Starter' bounty.

scripts.build: pnpm -F @wdk-starter/wdk-web-core build && pnpm -F @wdk-starter/wdk-ui build && pnpm -F @wdk-starter/extension build
